cohort: The participants were 7293 working mothers in Indonesia who gave birth in the five years prior to the 2017 Indonesia Demographic and Health Survey.
finding: Working mothers with health insurance were 1.536 times more likely to have a cesarean delivery than uninsured women (AOR 1.536; 95% CI 1.324-1.781).
mod_finding: Insured working mothers were 1.536 times more likely to have a cesarean delivery than uninsured working mothers.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from the 2017 Indonesia Demographic and Health Survey, analyzing births that occurred in the previous five years.
